description: Fired when the user presses Enter. Persist `value` and rebind value.value.

value.description: The committed value — a number for the numpad layout (clamped to [min,max] when config.enforceRange), a string for the text layouts.

text.description: numpad: the number formatted with decimals + units. text: the committed string.

isValid.description: Whether the value is within [min,max] (always true when enforceRange is false).
